title: Schedule overlap
skill: Define the boundaries and the output shape

good: Rewrite find_conflicts(meetings) in schedule.py. A meeting is a dict with id, room, start, end. Rules: 1) parse start and end ("H:MM" or "HH:MM", 24-hour) into minutes and compare numbers, not strings; 2) if end <= start, raise ValueError; 3) rooms are the same when room.strip().lower() is equal; 4) two meetings in the same room conflict when start_a < end_b and start_b < end_a, so touching (end == start) is not a conflict; 5) for each conflict add the tuple (min(id_a, id_b), max(id_a, id_b)), each pair once; 6) return sorted(pairs), a list of tuples; ids are strings and compare as strings ("m10" < "m2"). Keep the signature. Do not change booking.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: find_conflicts has bugs, please fix the room overlap check.
